beats.title: Choosing the Hidden Approach
beats.boundaryReason: The opening recap and route discussion stay with the party on the road below the mountains. The beat ends with the decision to leave the road and follow the stream; actual travel begins at u0345.
dateEvidence: The session manifest fixes both drStart and drEnd at 1748-04-12.
u0004 describes midmorning; u0339-u0340 explicitly establish about 10 o'clock. Recollections of earlier sessions are discussion, not a change of scene date.

beats.title: Following the Dwarven Stones
beats.boundaryReason: Overland travel becomes a search following numbered stones into the river valley, ending with the water test and naming Taster. Entry into the gorge begins at u0597.
dateEvidence: u0355 puts the first part of the approach about half an hour after departure; the noonday sun is introduced just after this beat at u0602.

beats.title: Opening the Flooded Passage
beats.boundaryReason: The gorge narrows into the flooded tunnel: the party leaves its horses, investigates the submerged barrier, and Riswynn pulls the chain to drain the passage. Keep this single obstacle together; onward tunnel travel begins at u1086.
dateEvidence: Same day, 1748-04-12; there is no rest or date transition.
u0602 explicitly describes the noonday sun; u0657-u0658 confirm it is about noon. The scouting swim and chain mechanism follow directly.

beats.title: Levers, Ladders, and Illusions
beats.boundaryReason: Onward travel leads through the spiral ascent, guard chamber, untested lever, ladder, and illusory rubble to the final hidden door. Its opening completes the passage exploration; the inhabited cavern is described from u1383.
dateEvidence: Same day, 1748-04-12, continuing from the noon entry.

u1091-u1094 describe further tunnel travel and a 30-40 minute ascent, followed by more walking at u1284-u1285 and u1345-u1347. Afternoon is an approximate inference from that elapsed travel, not a stated clock time.

beats.title: Bargaining with the Cavern's Ruler
beats.boundaryReason: The opened door reveals an occupied pool cavern and its white-haired ruler. The party establishes contact, seeks passage, agrees to help fight a threat, and assesses her intentions. She begins leading them onward at u1659.
dateEvidence: Continuous same-day exploration on 1748-04-12 after beat-004; no rest or date transition.
Approximate afternoon carries forward from the noon entry and subsequent underground travel.

beats.title: Into the Ruined Marketplace
beats.boundaryReason: The ruler leads the party across the pools to a large former marketplace. They question her about the threat, inspect the cavern, light it with torches, and advance. The first tentacle attack at u1849 is a clear combat boundary.
dateEvidence: Direct continuation of beat-005 on 1748-04-12, with only movement and conversation between the pool cavern and marketplace.
Approximate afternoon follows the preceding underground journey.

beats.title: Caught by Stone Tentacles
beats.boundaryReason: First phase of one continuous fight: the ambush catches Wellby, Delwath is also restrained, initial attacks fail, Thunderwave damages a tendril, and Wellby survives a bite and escapes with inspiration. End after his disengagement into cover; Kenzo begins assessing the creature at u2227.
dateEvidence: Combat begins immediately after beat-006 on 1748-04-12 and continues in successive turns.
Same approximate afternoon; no time or day transition.

beats.title: Breaking Free and Finding Range
beats.boundaryReason: Second phase of the same fight: Soul Sight and investigation clarify the enemy's defenses and limited mobility, Delwath teleports onto a roof, and ranged tactics develop. Kenzo severs the tendril holding Riswynn; the next beat starts with Seeker proposing the arrow-and-Heat-Metal combination.
dateEvidence: Uninterrupted combat on 1748-04-12, continuing directly from beat-007.
Same approximate afternoon; tactical movement and successive turns do not imply a date change.

beats.title: Burning Arrow, Fallen Monster
beats.boundaryReason: Final phase and immediate aftermath of the same fight: the initial glancing arrow cannot be heated, a later shot lodges, and Heat Metal and ranged attacks finish the creature. Keep the short victory exchange, directions onward, and closing table scheduling attached rather than creating a tiny final beat.
dateEvidence: The fight and immediate aftermath continue on 1748-04-12 without an in-world rest or date change.
Same approximate afternoon. Scheduling from u2842 concerns the next real-world game, not a transition in Taelgar.
